opinions: I BELIEVE THAT POSSESSING MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENSE.
I DISAGREE THAT A CIVILIZED SOCIETY REQUIRES A HIERARCHICAL STRUCTURE OF OBEDIENCE AND COMMAND.
I BELIEVE OUR CIVIL LIBERTIES ARE BEING EXCESSIVELY CURBED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM.
I BELIEVE PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR THE ADULT POPULATION.
I BELIEVE PEOPLE ARE ULTIMATELY DIVIDED MORE BY CLASS THAN BY NATIONALITY.
I DISAGREE THAT MOTHERS' FIRST DUTY IS TO BE HOMEMAKERS AND BELIEVE THEY CAN HAVE CAREERS AS WELL.
I BELIEVE ABSTRACT ART THAT DOESN’T REPRESENT ANYTHING SHOULD BE CONSIDERED ART.
I DISAGREE THAT IT’S FOOLISH TO BE PROUD OF ONE’S COUNTRY OF BIRTH.
I DISAGREE THAT ONLY WRONGDOERS NEED TO BE WORRIED ABOUT OFFICIAL SURVEILLANCE.
I BELIEVE A GENUINE FREE MARKET REQUIRES RESTRICTIONS ON MULTINATIONALS TO PREVENT MONOPOLIES.
I DISAGREE THAT BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS ARE MORE IMPORTANT THAN WRITERS AND ARTISTS.
I DISAGREE THAT THE DEATH PENALTY SHOULD BE AN OPTION FOR THE MOST SERIOUS CRIMES.
I DISAGREE THAT OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS GONE TOO FAR.
I DISAGREE THAT A ONE-PARTY STATE AVOIDS ARGUMENTS THAT DELAY PROGRESS.
I DISAGREE THAT GOOD PARENTS SOMETIMES HAVE TO SPANK THEIR CHILDREN.
I BELIEVE A SAME-SEX COUPLE IN A STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIP SHOULD HAVE THE POSSIBILITY OF CHILD ADOPTION.
I DISAGREE THAT FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN NEVER BE FULLY INTEGRATED WITHIN THEIR NEW COUNTRY.
I BELIEVE IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD BE MORE IMPORTANT THAN PUNISHMENT.
I STRONGLY DISAGREE THAT OUR RACE HAS MANY SUPERIOR QUALITIES COMPARED WITH OTHER RACES.
I DISAGREE THAT THE FREER THE MARKET, THE FREER THE PEOPLE.
I DISAGREE THAT THOSE WITH THE ABILITY TO PAY SHOULD HAVE ACCESS TO HIGHER STANDARDS OF MEDICAL CARE.
I DISAGREE THAT THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO EQUIP THE FUTURE GENERATION TO FIND JOBS.
I STRONGLY DISAGREE THAT DIFFERENT SORTS OF PEOPLE SHOULD KEEP TO THEIR OWN KIND.
I DISAGREE THAT IT IS A WASTE OF TIME TO TRY TO REHABILITATE SOME CRIMINALS.
I DISAGREE THAT ABORTION SHOULD ALWAYS BE ILLEGAL WHEN THE WOMAN’S LIFE IS NOT THREATENED.
I DISAGREE THAT SCHOOLS SHOULD NOT MAKE CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE COMPULSORY.
I DISAGREE THAT NO ONE CAN FEEL NATURALLY HOMOSEXUAL.
I DISAGREE THAT IT IS IMPORTANT FOR A CHILD’S SCHOOL TO INSTILL RELIGIOUS VALUES.
I BELIEVE CORPORATIONS REQUIRE REGULATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT.
I DISAGREE THAT THOSE ABLE TO WORK AND REFUSE SHOULD NOT EXPECT SOCIETY’S SUPPORT.
I BELIEVE THERE IS A WORRYING FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT.
I AGREE IT IS REGRETTABLE THAT MANY PERSONAL FORTUNES ARE MADE BY PEOPLE WHO MANIPULATE MONEY WITHOUT CONTRIBUTING TO SOCIETY.
I DISAGREE THAT MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS AN IMPORTANT ASPECT OF MATURITY.
I AGREE IT’S A SAD REFLECTION ON OUR SOCIETY THAT DRINKING WATER IS NOW A BOTTLED, BRANDED CONSUMER PRODUCT.
I BELIEVE THERE ARE NO SAVAGE AND CIVILIZED PEOPLES; THERE ARE ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES.
I DISAGREE THAT THE ONLY SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF A COMPANY SHOULD BE TO DELIVER A PROFIT TO ITS SHAREHOLDERS.
I BELIEVE ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED.
I DISAGREE THAT CHARITY IS BETTER THAN SOCIAL SECURITY FOR HELPING THE GENUINELY DISADVANTAGED.
I BELIEVE PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY IN TRADE.
I DISAGREE THAT NO BROADCASTING INSTITUTION SHOULD RECEIVE PUBLIC FUNDING.
I DISAGREE THAT THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS TO ACCEPT DISCIPLINE.
I BELIEVE LAND SHOULDN’T BE A COMMODITY TO BE BOUGHT AND SOLD.
I DISAGREE THAT SOME PEOPLE ARE NATURALLY UNLUCKY.
I DISAGREE THAT PEOPLE WITH SERIOUS INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD NOT BE ALLOWED TO REPRODUCE.
I BELIEVE 'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED' IS A FUNDAMENTALLY GOOD IDEA.
I DISAGREE THAT WHEN TROUBLED, IT’S BETTER NOT TO THINK ABOUT IT BUT TO KEEP BUSY WITH MORE CHEERFUL THINGS.
I DISAGREE THAT TAXPAYERS SHOULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO PROP UP THEATRES OR MUSEUMS THAT CANNOT SURVIVE ON A COMMERCIAL BASIS.
I DISAGREE THAT MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS SOMETIMES JUSTIFIED.
I DISAGREE THAT YOU CANNOT BE MORAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS.
I DISAGREE WITH THE PRINCIPLE OF 'AN EYE FOR AN EYE AND A TOOTH FOR A TOOTH.'
I DISAGREE THAT CONTROLLING INFLATION IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT.
I DISAGREE WITH THE PRINCIPLE THAT 'THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS MY FRIEND.'
I BELIEVE IF ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION IS INEVITABLE, IT SHOULD PRIMARILY SERVE HUMANITY RATHER THAN TRANSNATIONAL CORPORATIONS.
I DISAGREE THAT SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS USUALLY IMMORAL.
I BELIEVE GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT MISLEAD THE PUBLIC.
I AGREE WE SHOULD HEED THE WARNINGS OF CLIMATE SCIENCE RATHER THAN UNCRITICALLY PURSUE ECONOMIC GROWTH.
I DISAGREE THAT ONE SHOULD ALWAYS SUPPORT THEIR COUNTRY, WHETHER IT IS RIGHT OR WRONG.
I DISAGREE THAT ASTROLOGY ACCURATELY EXPLAINS MANY THINGS.
I DISAGREE THAT THE RICH ARE TOO HIGHLY TAXED.
I DISAGREE THAT WHAT’S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS ALWAYS GOOD FOR ALL OF US.
I BELIEVE WHAT GOES ON IN A PRIVATE BEDROOM BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS IS NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE.
I BELIEVE IT’S NATURAL FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS.
